note: schema_type! / schema! fixes: a same-named variant whose file no longer parses (mid-edit in an IDE) is kept instead of being dropped, so the imported item is no longer confused with another module's; a schema! pick/omit name selects the field whose Rust identifier it is (a JSON name equal to another field's identifier no longer selects both), and a JSON name shared by several fields is refused with a spanned error.
